storyCards.headline: Death Bed: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Powfu's "Death Bed" reached #23 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Death Bed (Coffee for Your Head)" (stylized in all lowercase) is a song by Canadian rapper and singer Powfu featuring Filipino-English singer-songwriter Beabadoobee.

The song peaked at #23 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 26 weeks on the chart.

Death Bed was released in 2020.
